Question: When updating vendor details as an individual with Singpass, what happens if the government database connectivity fails?
Answer:
Direct answer:
If the government database connectivity fails, the name field/Vendor Name can be updated manually. Once connectivity is restored, the name will be retrieved from the government database (MyInfo) again.

Supporting details from the sources:
- In the View/Update Vendor Record Details section: “Upon each login, vendor name is retrieved from Government database- MyInfo and is not editable. ... In the unlikely event where the connectivity to the government database fails, the name field will then be available for updating. However, if you choose not to do the manual update, your name will be retrieved from MyInfo when the connectivity is restored.” This indicates a manual update path during outages and automatic resynchronization when connectivity returns. (Source: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, pages 19–21)

Additional context relevant to Singpass users:
- For individuals with Singpass, the vendor name is auto-populated from MyInfo and not editable, but manual updates are possible if connectivity to the government database fails. (Source: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, page 21)

Cited sources:
- Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, pages 19–21 (Vendor Record Details workflow and MyInfo behavior)
- Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, page 21 (Singpass-related auto-population note)

Sources Used: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf (pages 19–21)

Question: What is the difference between how the Official Name and Vendor Name fields are populated for a local company?
Answer:
- Official Name: Sourced from the government database Enterprise Data Hub (EDH). It is the authoritative name and is used as the source value for naming. It is described as “Official name registered and retrieved from the government database - EDH” and is not edited by the user.

- Vendor Name: Automatically populated from the Official Name and displayed as the first 80 characters. It is non-editable by the user; the Vendor Name field shows the first 80 characters of the Official Name and cannot be changed.

In short, Official Name comes from EDH and is the true source; Vendor Name is a non-editable, truncated (first 80 characters) display derived from that Official Name. 

Sources:
- Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, pages 7 (Vendor Name derived from Official Name and EDH) 
- Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, pages 22 (EDH-derived Official Name, 80-character Vendor Name, non-editable Vendor Name)

Question: Under what three conditions will a vendor record be made inactive?
Answer:
- A vendor record will be made inactive if:
  1) There is no activity for more than 2 years; or
  2) There was a failed interbank GIRO (IBG) payment to the vendor’s bank account; or
  3) You or your client agency has requested the vendor record inactivation.

Question: What can a vendor do to reactivate an inactive vendor record?
Answer:
To reactivate an inactive vendor record, log in to Vendors@Gov and click the “Reactivate” button. After the vendor record is activated, you may update your vendor record details in the portal. (Source: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Vendor Record Status section, page 36; and related pages in the same document) [Source file: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, pages 35–37].

Question: What are the three authorisation clauses a new vendor agrees to when creating a vendor record?
Answer:
The three authorisation clauses described for a new vendor creation are:

- Authorisation to authorize government and statutory boards.
- Authorization to request/verify information regarding the account.
- Authorization to verify bank details as part of the creation process.

Question: Can a foreign individual without Singpass update their vendor record details directly on Vendors@Gov?
Answer:
Direct answer: No. A foreign individual who does not have Singpass cannot update vendor record details in Vendors@Gov. They are advised to approach the liaison officer at their client agency to update their vendor details in the Government Financial System (NFS@Gov) instead. This constraint is stated in the vendor onboarding/update guidance related to MOF10, Singpass absence, and updates restrictions (maintenance windows and agency-specific limitations).

Question: What are the system maintenance windows during which vendor details cannot be updated?
Answer:
- System maintenance windows when vendor details cannot be updated:
  - 05:00 to 06:00 (GMT+8)
  - 19:00 to 19:30 (GMT+8)
  - These windows occur from Monday to Saturday.
